title: GrowthBook scroll rail
description: A short multicolour light (navy, violet, white, blue, navy, teal, mint) that rides a thin vertical rule or a card's left edge, travelling down it as the section scrolls past.
notes: place it inside a relatively positioned box; it sits on that box's left edge (or right with side="right")
CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it, and reduced motion, show it resting at the top
name: growthbook-rail

props.name: side
props.description: which edge of the positioned parent it rides

props.name: fixed
props.description: fixed: the gradient fills the whole edge and stays still (the card-edge variant)

props.name: className
props.description: bar width in px-ish Tailwind classes, e.g. "w-[3px]" (default)
